headline: A 2008 executive order sets new pay rates for certain federal workers and officials, likely for the year 2009.
what_it_does: This order adjusts pay rates for certain groups paid by the federal government. Only the title is available, so the exact groups and amounts are not given here. Orders with this title are usually issued each year to set the coming year's pay tables for federal employees.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be changed under the new pay tables set by the order.
